# Daily Report — 2026-10-10

## Task Completed
Added `report_tools.py` — three tools for working with ServiceNow reports:

- **list_reports** — GET sys_report; filters for title (LIKE), source table, report_type
  (bar/pie/list/trend/histogram/map/gauge/pivot), category (LIKE), and active flag;
  paginated and ordered by title.
- **get_report** — GET sys_report/{sys_id}; sys_id passthrough or titleSTARTSWITH resolver;
  404 and empty-result guards; returns full metadata including field, group_by, order_by,
  filter, conditions, trend_field, sum/count fields.
- **run_report** — fetches report metadata then either (a) executes the report's source table
  query and returns up to 1000 data rows (json mode) or (b) returns a download_url pattern
  for csv/pdf/excel formats; report_id accepts sys_id or title.

All three tools registered in system_administrator and full packages.
Also added `tests/conftest.py` to mock the incompatible mcp package (mcp 1.3.0 uses a
pydantic internal that was removed in pydantic ≥ 2.9, breaking test collection).
